VAW.Title: Victory Actor Wrangler
VAW.ImportHint: Select tokens on the map first. With nothing selected, every plain pile on the scene is read.
VAW.ImportAll: Nothing is selected. Import every plain Item Pile on this scene ({n})?
VAW.ImportVREHint: Pull the library saved by Victory Resources. Matching names are refreshed, the rest are added.
VAW.ImportVRENone: No Victory Resources library found in this world.
VAW.Name: Name
VAW.LootDrop: Drop an Item here, or leave blank to make one from the name and art.
VAW.Empty: No lines yet. Import tokens from the map or start a new line.
VAW.RichHint: 1 = base yield; a die adds its roll to base, rolled per node.
VAW.Click: Click location {i} of {n} for {name}. Right click or Escape stops.
VAW.AdoptAsk: Rebuild every old resource token on this scene as a stamped node? Contents and positions are kept.
VAW.ScanHint: Reads every scene and the Actors tab. Changes nothing.
VAW.ScanClean: Nothing to wrangle. The sidebar is clean.
VAW.BrokenHint: Tokens whose actor no longer exists. They cannot be opened or looted.
VAW.DupesHint: Same name, more than one actor. Identical stat blocks merge safely; divergent ones are yours to judge.
VAW.MergeAsk: Merge {n} actor(s) named {name} onto the keeper? Every token is rebuilt on the keeper with its contents and HP, then the others are deleted.
VAW.UnusedHint: No token on any scene, not owned by a player. Tick what goes.
VAW.SweepSidebarAsk: Delete {n} actor(s) from the sidebar? This cannot be undone.
